title: Downward health transition (🔴→🟢 resolution) is unpinned — and the claimed @t400 'host resolution' capture actually shows the host still Red
evidence: demos/node_health.dem: "at 20000ms draw 1 2 standard" / "capture at 20000ms" / "#   tick 400 (20s):  the host pile (pool-capped) red + growth content_hosts / #                    red; ... The host pipe draw lands / #                    this tick (the recovery begins in the T1 tail)." — _pr_body.md:98: "hosts red @t200, the host resolution + growth persistence @t400, connected" — stories-v2.md:487: "(amber pin @t1, red host + growth-born red @t200, host resolution @t400 — growth-born". Verified by exact replication (probe hashes matched goldens/node_health.t1 at ticks 1/200/400: 23550fd3b75263b2 / 9a662342dce4500d / 28bab9b8ab5e8523): host[2]=Red at tick 400, host[2]=None first at tick 401 (the draw applies at floor(20000·20/1000)+1=401 per harness/run.odin apply_tick_at).
detail: No test pins a Red→None node_health transition: the threshold test only ascends; the coherence fixture never resolves; the last T2 capture misses the resolution by one tick. The @t400 claims in PR body and story card misdescribe the golden.
recommended_fix: Add `capture at 20500ms` (post-resolution green host) to node_health.dem, and a unit test that draws the rescue pipe and asserts node_health goes Red→None.

title: Dead/demolished slot → .None branch of node_health_evaluate has no test (4.1's twin branch has one)
detail: The dead-slot write is an untested health-state branch. Consequence is currently invisible (draw_nodes `continue`s on !node_alive; the card guards node_alive), but the sibling 4.1 module pins its equivalent.
recommended_fix: Mirror test_warning_dead_node_silent: demolish a strained node mid-run and assert node_health[slot] == .None afterwards.

title: PR body overstates the replay pin: 'live == replay levels at every tick' — the test compares only the final-tick levels snapshot
evidence: _pr_body.md:66-68: "pinned by / test_node_health_replay_derives_identically (live == replay levels at / every tick AND the hash sequence)." — the test takes ONE snapshot per run, after 120 ticks: node_health_test.odin:125-127 "live_hashes := record_run(&live, 120, cat) / ... / live_levels := node_health_snapshot(&live)" and 140-142 for replay; per-tick comparison is only on hashes, which exclude node_health (verified: serialize.odin state_writer writes node_strain/pipe_strain/forecast/active only).
detail: Per-tick level equality is implied (identical hashes → identical inputs → pure derivation) but never directly asserted; the claim 'at every tick' describes an implication, not the pin.
recommended_fix: Either record per-tick level snapshots inside record_run and compare them, or soften the PR-body wording to 'final levels + per-tick hash sequence'.

title: Hover inspect card render (P2 app surface) has no automated pin — sanctioned by the app-layer-only convention
evidence: app/main.odin: "if (app.mode == .Run || app.mode == .Paused) && app.placing < 0 && !app.drag.active {" ... "rnd.draw_node_health_card(...)" — app/render/node_health.odin: "draw_node_health_card :: proc(...)" with NODE_HEALTH_CARD_W/H geometry and the STRAINED/CRITICAL/HEALTHY name mapping — no @(test) or golden references it (harness capture_frame never calls draw_hud; verified harness run: 29/29 green with the card absent from T2s).
detail: The card's layout, state-name mapping, and hover gating are untested. This matches the project convention (app chrome stays outside harness capture; 5.3 chip precedent), and the numbers it renders are pinned in core.
recommended_fix: Acceptable as-is per convention; if desired later, extract node_health_card_state name/glyph mapping into a core-pinnable pure proc.
